author: F. G. Butler
title: Search underway for missing elderly woman in Spring Hill
text:
Chris Nocco, Pasco County Sheriff | https://www.pascosheriff.com/
Chris Nocco, Pasco County Sheriff | https://www.pascosheriff.com/
Pasco County Sheriff's deputies are looking for Lawana Yochim, a 74-year-old woman who has been reported missing. According to authorities, Yochim is described as being 5 feet 6 inches tall, weighing about 175 pounds, with blonde or gray hair and blue eyes.
She was last seen on March 3 at approximately 10 a.m. in the St. Paul Drive area of Spring Hill. It is not known what clothing she was wearing at the time she disappeared. Officials believe she may be driving a silver 2016 Nissan Versa with Florida license plate CN74VM.
The sheriff’s office asks that anyone with information about Yochim's location contact the Pasco Sheriff’s Non-Emergency Line at 727-847-8102, option 7. Tips can also be submitted online through the agency’s website at http://PascoSheriff.com/tips.
